description: See what your photos reveal, then remove the EXIF data — without uploading them. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: 'inspect' lists the metadata found (camera, time, location) without changing the file. 'strip' returns the same image with that metadata removed, losslessly.

data.description: The image file as base64: a JPEG, PNG or WebP. The format is detected from the bytes, and files over 50 MB are refused.

keepColourProfile.description: Keep the ICC colour profile when stripping. Set false to remove it too, which can visibly shift the colours on wide-gamut screens.

keepOrientation.description: Keep the EXIF orientation flag when stripping, so a phone photo does not turn on its side. Set false to remove it with everything else.

name.description: A filename echoed back with a strip result. It does not affect what is removed.

name: exif_remover
title: Remove EXIF Data
